headline: Egypt Accelerates Renewable Energy Target to 45% Share by 2028
summary: President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi reviewed national plans to bring forward Egypt's renewable energy target to 45% of the power mix by 2028, expanding investments into battery storage, green hydrogen, and mineral processing.
why: Egypt is accelerating its green transition to lower domestic reliance on natural gas and attract international clean-energy investments and multilateral climate financing.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Accelerated state targets will spur capital deployment into domestic solar, wind, and battery storage projects.
